_comment: Rationale for these keys lives in core/pipeline.py, in the comment block immediately above _render_fcl_overrides. desc_fmt/output_glob/njobs are per-stage orchestration constants -- desc_fmt is the json2jobdef description format, output_glob is the file pattern this stage emits, njobs is the default grid job count (mode specs may override via run.jobs_per_stage; see core/pipeline.py stage_cfg()). No 'input_data'/'resampler_name': digi reads the prior stage's (mustops_ce) art files directly, staged dynamically by cmd_submit's stage_hardlink_farm -- same mechanism as mustops_ce, not a resampler.
